feature.source_obligation: Table 369 requires Warichu to contain the ordered sequence WP, WT, WP; it says WP typically contains text. Table 355 makes K optional; the candidate WP elements omit it. The revised source fixture uses WP elements with absent K and a WT with two page-local line MCRs; a separate paragraph is on page 2.
